intro.text: A guard at the Thaylen Gemstone Reserve in Thaylen City.

items.text: On the day of the battle at Thaylen City, Tlik guarded the inner door of the Reserve's sphere vault with a crossbow. He let in Rysn Ftori and Vstim, who gave the passcode, along with a member of the queen's guard.

Tlik helped move Rysn from her wheelchair to a smaller carried chair and bore her deeper into the vault. When Vstim opened the vault holding the King's Drop, the queen's guard suddenly stabbed Tlik in the neck and seized the gem, then shot back with Tlik's crossbow. The killer proved to be one of the Fused.

personality.text: He is friendly with Rysn, who often works in the vault, and joked that the spheres must look like a buffet to Chiri-Chiri when the larkin sneaked in.
